g.text: skip tags that name no trait
The backend layer references nothing from Behat, Mink or the
layers above it, so it is usable without Behat loaded. The root
of each of the 2 lower layers, outside its Drupal sub-namespace,
references no Drupal class beyond the random generator, and
neither does the web half of the vocabulary.
scripts/lint-layers.php fails the build on any of them.
